name: Eshtaol
overview: Eshtaol is a town associated with both the tribe of Judah and the tribe of Dan, as Scripture records its location in the territory of Judah (Joshua 15:33) and its allotment to Dan (Joshua 19:41). It is notably connected to the life of Samson, who was moved by the Spirit of the Lord near Eshtaol (Judges 13:25) and was buried nearby after his death (Judges 16:31). The town also served as a strategic point for the Danites when scouting the land, highlighting its significance in the unfolding history of Israel (Judges 18:2, 18:8).
